context: Output settled at 49 articles over five completed cycles with freshness comfortably inside target (median 0.4 days, max 1.1) and source concentration low — Dawn at 12% of 45 unique outlets. Two politics articles shipped under near-identical headlines, 'Court Blocks Mail-Ballot Rule' (03:33) and 'Court Blocks Mail Ballot Rules' (21:58); they are genuinely different stories with no overlapping sources — the ruling, then the Justice Department's compliance statement — but the second title describes the first story's news, so the homepage reads as a duplicate. This is the known title-layer dedup gap: layer 5 only gates niche-only stories, so two multi-source dispatches on one event pass through under the same headline. Neither the fix (scripts/lib/dedup.js) nor the second-title framing (write-prompt.md) is a tunable parameter, so this is surfaced to the operator rather than acted on.
